tasks.title: Welcome to Flutter Clean Starter
tasks.notes: This sample task is seeded from bundled JSON through the fake API. Delete the Tasks feature to start your own app.

tasks.title: Explore the architecture
tasks.notes: Open docs/ARCHITECTURE.md to see how the layers fit together.

tasks.title: Run the test suite
tasks.notes: Run fvm flutter test to see the example tests for every layer.

tasks.title: Swap the fake API for a real one
tasks.notes: FakeTaskApi implements TaskApi: write a dio-based implementation and register it in the DI module instead.

tasks.title: Rename the project
tasks.notes: Follow docs/TEMPLATE_USAGE.md to rename the package, the app IDs and the display name with tool/rename.dart.
